eligibility and student transfer procedures. And those two policies left gaps within the overall process. re-evaluations. There's a section for triennial re-evaluation. Eligibility. environment. We now have a section for placement. We also discuss procedural safeguards. We discuss prior written notices. We define related services. We captured the process of amending an IEP, and then we talk about the prohibited practices of harassment. Okay. Thank you, Ms. Richardson. That's quite a bit. Committee members, before we make a motion, would love to hear your thoughts on the changes to Policy 5310 as well as 5330 in conjunction.

Ms. Labelle? I just want to look at triennial re-evaluation. What would be some instances other than graduation that would cause that to be unnecessary?

Sure. So this comes directly from code- Okay ... or regulation. So we have the obligation to come together at least every three years, and when you come together as that triennial team, you can discuss about the student's present levels of performance, progress towards goals, how they're accessing their accommodations, and the team can choose to just simply do a review of records and document that for the triennial process.

So you don't always have to choose the formal components that are done by our psychologist and educational diagnosticians. Is the review of records, does it become part of the child's records? Yes. So that if we are looking at it and we say, "Oh, he's not had a triennial review," we can see that there, yes, there has been a review of records. Yes. Okay. Thank you. Absolutely. Ms. Chandler?

So 504, so that is Section

504 under the Americans with Disabilities Act. The terminology of looking at whether we suspect whether a child has a disability is still called child study.

In LCPS, I'm not sure of the timeframe in which we changed, we refer to that exact process as the referral review team. And so because we do call it RRT currently- Mm-hmm

... we did want this policy to accurately reflect how it's captured in the IDEA and in state regs. Can't say that, but due to some of these changes, some of the things that are in policy, he has to go to those teachers and say, "Unfortunately, we have to involuntarily de-staff." We also have some space concerns over at Lightridge.
